//! @generated — modul `komponen`. Hanya data dan aturan pohon; tidak ada kode
//! yang menyentuh piksel maupun jendela.

pub mod state;
pub mod tree;

pub use state::{Event, State, Value};
pub use tree::NodeExt;

pub use crate::core::{Align, Axis, Color, Point, Rect, Size};

pub type NodeId = u64;
pub type AssetId = u32;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Paint {
    Solid(Color),
    Image(AssetId),
    Unsupported(UnsupportedPaint),
}

impl Paint {
    pub fn color(&self) -> Color {
        match self {
            Self::Solid(color) => *color,
            Self::Unsupported(value) => value.fallback,
            Self::Image(_) => Color::TRANSPARENT,
        }
    }
}

/// A paint FigCraft understands but this generator cannot reproduce exactly.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct UnsupportedPaint {
    pub kind: String,
    pub fallback: Color,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Padding {
    pub top: f32,
    pub right: f32,
    pub bottom: f32,
    pub left: f32,
}

impl Padding {
    pub const fn uniform(value: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            top: value,
            right: value,
            bottom: value,
            left: value,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Style {
    pub fill: Option<Paint>,
    pub stroke: Option<Paint>,
    pub stroke_width: f32,
    pub corner_radius: f32,
    pub opacity: f32,
    pub clips_content: bool,
}

impl Style {
    pub fn effective_opacity(&self) -> f32 {
        self.opacity.clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ShapeKind {
    Rectangle,
    Ellipse,
    Line,
    Vector,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TextAlignVertical {
    #[default]
    Top,
    Center,
    Bottom,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct TextSpec {
    pub text: String,
    pub font_family: String,
    pub font_size: f32,
    pub bold: bool,
    pub italic: bool,
    pub align: Align,
    pub vertical_align: TextAlignVertical,
    pub line_height: f32,
    pub color: Color,
    pub bindings: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct FrameSpec {
    pub layout: Axis,
    pub gap: f32,
    pub padding: Padding,
    pub align: Align,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WidgetKind {
    Button,
    TextInput,
    TextArea,
    Checkbox,
    RadioButton,
    Switch,
    Slider,
    ProgressBar,
    Dropdown,
    ListBox,
    Menu,
    MenuItem,
    Tabs,
    TabItem,
    Tooltip,
    Modal,
    Accordion,
    Custom(String),
}

impl WidgetKind {
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str {
        match self {
            Self::Button => "Button",
            Self::TextInput => "TextInput",
            Self::TextArea => "TextArea",
            Self::Checkbox => "Checkbox",
            Self::RadioButton => "RadioButton",
            Self::Switch => "Switch",
            Self::Slider => "Slider",
            Self::ProgressBar => "ProgressBar",
            Self::Dropdown => "Dropdown",
            Self::ListBox => "ListBox",
            Self::Menu => "Menu",
            Self::MenuItem => "MenuItem",
            Self::Tabs => "Tabs",
            Self::TabItem => "TabItem",
            Self::Tooltip => "Tooltip",
            Self::Modal => "Modal",
            Self::Accordion => "Accordion",
            Self::Custom(_) => "Custom",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct WidgetSpec {
    pub kind: WidgetKind,
    pub label: Option<String>,
    pub binding: Option<String>,
    pub options: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Kind {
    Frame(FrameSpec),
    Shape(ShapeKind),
    Text(TextSpec),
    Image { asset: AssetId },
    Widget(WidgetSpec),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Node {
    pub id: NodeId,
    pub name: String,
    /// Selalu relatif terhadap induk.
    pub rect: Rect,
    pub style: Style,
    pub kind: Kind,
    pub visible: bool,
    pub locked: bool,
    pub children: Vec<Node>,
}

impl Node {
    pub fn point(&self) -> Point {
        self.rect.origin
    }

    pub fn size(&self) -> Size {
        self.rect.size
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Asset {
    pub id: AssetId,
    pub name: String,
    pub mime: String,
    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Pohon desain statis hasil export. Perilaku ada di `State` dan `user`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Component {
    pub name: String,
    pub design_size: Size,
    pub root: Vec<Node>,
    pub assets: Vec<Asset>,
}

impl Component {
    pub fn asset(&self, id: AssetId) -> Option<&Asset> {
        self.assets.iter().find(|asset| asset.id == id)
    }

    pub fn node(&self, id: NodeId) -> Option<&Node> {
        self.root.iter().find_map(|root| root.find(id))
    }

    pub fn bindings(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut found = Vec::new();
        for root in &self.root {
            root.walk(&mut |node| {
                let keys: Vec<&String> = match &node.kind {
                    Kind::Text(spec) => spec.bindings.iter().collect(),
                    Kind::Widget(spec) => spec.binding.iter().collect(),
                    _ => Vec::new(),
                };
                for key in keys {
                    if !found.contains(key) {
                        found.push(key.clone());
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        found
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn component_finds_nodes_and_bindings() {
        let text = Node {
            id: 2,
            name: "Title".into(),
            rect: Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
            style: Style::default(),
            kind: Kind::Text(TextSpec {
                text: "Hi {{name}}".into(),
                font_family: "sans".into(),
                font_size: 12.0,
                bold: false,
                italic: false,
                align: Align::Start,
                vertical_align: TextAlignVertical::Top,
                line_height: 0.0,
                color: Color::BLACK,
                bindings: vec!["name".into()],
            }),
            visible: true,
            locked: false,
            children: Vec::new(),
        };
        let component = Component {
            name: "test".into(),
            design_size: Size::new(10.0, 10.0),
            root: vec![Node {
                id: 1,
                name: "root".into(),
                rect: Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
                style: Style::default(),
                kind: Kind::Frame(FrameSpec {
                    layout: Axis::None,
                    gap: 0.0,
                    padding: Padding::default(),
                    align: Align::Start,
                }),
                visible: true,
                locked: false,
                children: vec![text],
            }],
            assets: Vec::new(),
        };
        assert!(component.node(2).is_some());
        assert_eq!(component.bindings(), vec!["name".to_string()]);
    }
}
